copy.curiosityHook: As France's most famous outlaw feeds on public fascination, can his calculated charisma survive escalating pressure from the law?
copy.description: After two decades of daring criminal exploits that won him national notoriety and headlines, French outlaw Jacques Mesrine grapples with mounting paranoia and isolation as authorities prepare for a final reckoning.
copy.vibeSummary: Tense, character-driven crime drama with high emotional stakes and deliberate, suspenseful pacing.
copy.whyWatch: Jean-François Richet delivers a gritty, high-stakes crime thriller that balances explosive outlaw spectacle with the heavy psychological toll of fame and isolation.
